findings.title: immediateDelete cancels at SendGrid but never removes the WorkflowReminder row
findings.body: With `immediateDelete` the function sends the cancel request and returns at line 222 without deleting or marking the row. Callers using `true` are handleNewBooking (reschedule) and the workflow delete and step delete paths in workflows.tsx. For the reschedule path the row stays attached to the old booking with `scheduled: true` and `cancelled: null`. The cron only cleans rows where `cancelled: true`, so the row is never removed. The SMS path deletes the row, so the two channels now behave differently. Delete the row after the cancel request succeeds.

findings.title: One failing cancel aborts the rest of the batch
findings.body: The whole loop is inside one try, and the DB deletes are only queued and awaited after the loop. If one SendGrid request throws, the loop stops and none of the queued deletes run. Every remaining cancelled reminder is retried on the next run, and a permanently failing reminder blocks all the ones after it. Handle errors per reminder. Also, `console.log` is used for the error.

findings.title: Reminder cancellation is not awaited
findings.body: The old code awaited the `deleteMany` calls. The deletes here are now fire-and-forget (`forEach(async ...)` and unawaited calls). A serverless handler can return before the DB updates and deletes finish, which would leave reminders uncancelled, for example in the edited-steps path. Collect the promises and `await Promise.all` them. The same applies to bookings.tsx:489 and handleCancelBooking.ts:487.

findings.title: Unrelated whitespace churn inside a commented block
findings.body: Indentation of a commented-out block was stripped, which adds noise to the diff. The `Prisma` import at line 9 also has no trailing comma. Revert the whitespace changes.

contracts.action: Cancel email/SMS reminders on booking cancel, reschedule, and workflow edits
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous code: cancel and DELETE at SendGrid, then deleteMany in the caller
contracts.before_after: Now the manager marks the row cancelled (email) or deletes it (SMS), and a cron cancels email batches within 1h of scheduledDate. With immediateDelete the email row is neither marked nor deleted.
contracts.visible_effect: Cancelled and rescheduled reminders are not sent, but stale rows remain on the immediateDelete path.
contracts.failure_mode: Errors are only logged, and the unawaited calls may not finish before the response returns.

summary: The change is mostly sound, but the `immediateDelete` email path leaves orphan WorkflowReminder rows. The cron cancel loop aborts on the first failure. Reminder cancellation is no longer awaited. There is also stray whitespace churn in workflows.tsx.
